_note: Tool Belt stage 1 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-24-tool-belt-design.md). One tool per self-defense technique, words and effects from drafts/content/tool-belt-stage-1.md (Jay: 'Draft is OK', Nov 24). trigger = what the player does that fires it (greatCounter, block, strike, dash, crowded, hit); cooldownTicks = wait before it can fire again (20 ticks = 1 second); anim = the hero motion played when it fires (stand-ins until new art). Effects use packages/sim/src/effects.ts types; areaHit hits every enemy within its radius of the hero. Numbers are starting guesses, tuned with the balance bots.

tools.name: Off the Line
tools.reminder: Step off the line, parry, double punch.
tools.text: You step aside and add two quick punches.

tools.name: Other Side
tools.reminder: Same as #1, stepping the other way.
tools.text: You slip to the other side: DASH is ready again, and you pop the attacker with a quick punch.

tools.name: Spin Back Fist
tools.reminder: Inside block, step across, spin, back fist.
tools.text: You spin and your back fist hits everyone close to you.

tools.name: Open
tools.reminder: Outside block, punch to the body, step in, punch high.
tools.text: Body, then head: two punches drive the attacker back.

tools.name: Spin Elbow
tools.reminder: Inside block, spin with an elbow, finish with a back fist.
tools.text: Too many close? You spin with an elbow and a back fist that hit all of them.

tools.name: Arm Wrap
tools.reminder: Outside block, wrap the arm, strike, strike, elbow.
tools.text: You trap the arm: the attacker is stuck longer while three quick strikes land.

tools.name: Palm Heel
tools.reminder: Outside block, wrap and trap, palm heel.
tools.text: One big palm heel: your counter hits much harder.

tools.name: Block and Strike
tools.reminder: Outside block and strike to the body at the same moment.
tools.text: You block and hit back at the same moment.

tools.name: High Block Strike
tools.reminder: Outside block and strike high at the same moment.
tools.text: You block and hit back high: the attacker is knocked off-balance.

tools.name: Grab and Strike
tools.reminder: Double knifehand block, grab the arm, back fist.
tools.text: You grab the arm and hold the attacker still, then back fist.

tools.name: Osotogari
tools.reminder: Outside block, big leg reap, punch.
tools.text: You take the attacker to the ground for a moment.

tools.name: Reap and Finish
tools.reminder: Osotogari, punch, then finish on the ground.
tools.text: Kick an enemy that's on the ground for a big finishing hit.

tools.name: Inside Kick
tools.reminder: Jump to fighting stance, inside kick the weapon away.
tools.text: As you dash, you kick the weapon aside: the closest enemy's next hit is weaker.

tools.name: Kick and Spin
tools.reminder: Inside kick the weapon, turn, spin kick high.
tools.text: Dash in with a spin kick that hits everyone close, and their next two hits are weaker.

tools.name: Slip and Double
tools.reminder: Step aside, parry, outside block, double punch.
tools.text: Got hit? You slip to the side and answer with two quick punches.
